MPTC GEARS UP FOR UNDAS 2025

Metro Pacific Tollways Corporation (MPTC) is reactivating its “Biyaheng Arangkada” Motorists Assistance Program to ensure safe and convenient travel during the Undas season. With an expected surge in traffic across NLEX, SCTEX, NLEX Connector, CALAX, CAVITEX, and CCLEX, MPTC is intensifying operations through increased personnel deployment, 24/7 traffic monitoring, and quick-response teams.

More info: https://t.co/udTyjHiYM6

Over the past weeks, Duterte-aligned propagandists led by Kiko Barzaga have been using real frustrations in Mindanao for cheap political points. As I told in this interview for the @SCMPNews , they are cynically exploiting long-standing grievances about inequality and neglect — grievances that the Dutertes themselves failed to fix after six years in Malacañang. What is coming out from the Duterte propaganda machine is not about genuinely advocating for Mindanao secession but more about consolidating the Duterte bailiwick. It’s a political pressure tactic; a way to frame themselves as victims of “Imperial Manila” and rally regional loyalty now that their national influence weakens. A similar campaign centered on federalism got Duterte to the presidency in 2016 but it was dropped from the government agenda as soon as its political use is done. The Dutertes use these kinds of propaganda— from federalism to Mindanao secession— to preserve their hold over Mindanao politics and deflect accountability for corruption, governance failures, and their falling national standing. Few things are more emotionally charged and mobilizing than invoking a “Mindanao versus Manila” narrative, so they’re using it to shore up loyalty and praying that it will insulate their base from erosion.

JUSTICE FOR MISSING SABUNGEROS

Nagdaos ng misa, vigil, at protest action ang pamilya ng mga nawawalang sabungero sa Manila Arena at Department of Justice (DOJ) sa Padre Faura para ipanawagan ang pagpapanagot sa mga umano'y sangkot sa krimen.

Kinuwestiyon ng Justice for Missing Sabungeros Network (JMSN) ang mabagal anilang usad sa imbestigasyon at pag-iisyu ng arrest warrants.

“Justice for the missing sabungeros is justice for all who have suffered under impunity. The DOJ must act without further delay,” ayon sa spokesperson ng grupo na si Ted Lazaro.

📸: Justice for Missing Sabungeros Network
